newsitem.title: FRANCE: French govt deficit to be 288 bln Ffr in 96.
newsitem.headline: French govt deficit to be 288 bln Ffr in 96.

text.p: The French goverment said on Thursday that its core budget deficit for 1996 should be 288 billion francs, a reduction of 60 billion francs over two years.

"The deficit of the state budget has been brought down from 349 billion francs in 1994 excluding net privatisation receipts to 323 billion in 1995 and should be 288 billion francs in 1996," the government said in a statement.
The statement was part of the government's tax reform package in which it announced plans to cut income taxes by 75 billion francs over five years.
The government has been seeking to cut the country's deficit to meet conditions for European monetary union set to go into effect in 1999.
